verdict: Meta is delivering; Google spend needs to be redirected before more is lost.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.85 per lead, all driven by Meta — and the most recent 7 days show that momentum is building, with leads up 8% and cost per lead edging down. Google Ads, however, spent $507 over the same window and produced zero leads, despite 112 clicks reaching your site — this is a confirmed spend issue, not a reporting gap, and Google is being paused and restructured before any further budget runs. Your Google Business Profile generated 41 direction requests this period but zero calls, which points to a misconfigured or broken call button; that is being investigated and corrected now. Next period, you should expect Google to re-enter with a rebuilt campaign structure, and the call path on your profile to be restored so that local intent converts into contact.
